messages:
Maya (PM): quick one — i want to lock the recruitment + consent + metrics plan for the Early Access cohort (Private Deploy). target: 6 customers, 8-week engagement window. thoughts?

Sam (Eng): sounds good. can we narrow success metrics? latency/cost delta baseline + qualitative integration friction?

Maya (PM): yes — proposal: 1) 95th p50 p95 latency vs hosted baseline, 2) per-token unit cost delta, 3) integration time (days to first inference), 4) qualitative score from partner weekly check-ins.

Jordan (ProdOps): agree. add 'operational readiness' metric: # incidents per week and mean time to fallback. if they hit >2 incidents/week we pause rollout.

Priya (Research): for qualitative we'll run 10 standard prompt jobs and 5 customer-specific prompts weekly to catch regressions. need a simple eval harness we can run remotely.

Alex (Solutions): recruitment note — prefer customers with existing MLP workloads and privacy constraints (HIPAA/PII). they'll care about KMS/HSM and audit logs. willing to take 1-2 smaller beta shops for breadth.

Nina (Legal): consent + data handling checklist: 1) signed EA agreement, 2) data ingestion scope (no raw PII unless explicitly permitted), 3) opt-in for logs & telemetry, 4) retention window & deletion SLA. also need a simple addendum for on-prem installs.

Maya (PM): good call. i'm imagining a 2-tier consent: telemetry (mandatory aggregated), logs/traces (opt-in). add a short FAQ explaining what we store and why.

Sam (Eng): on telemetry - we can ship an anonymized perf-only heartbeat (no call payload). for optional traces we need hashed prompt ids and a toggle in config.

Priya (Research): for eval harness we can give them a runnable Docker image that uploads metrics to a bucket with an ingest token. minimal footprint.

Alex (Solutions): incentive structure — offer 12 weeks of discounted Dedicated credits + 1:1 onboarding time (4 hours) + priority support. consider a $5k credit or equivalent depending on size.

Jordan (ProdOps): schedule: recruitment 2 weeks, onboarding 1 week, 8-week engagement, 2-week wrap + postmortem. total ~13 weeks.

Maya (PM): screening questions draft — please review: ```
1) Primary use case and expected RPS?
2) Typical sequence lengths and prompt size?
3) Required compliance & infra (VPC, KMS)?
4) Contact person for integration + SRE?
5) Are you able to commit to weekly check-ins?
```

Sam (Eng): add: do you use batching or prefix caching today? helps us size kv-cache.

Priya (Research): add: do you have a small set of representative prompts we can test? (we'll keep them private)

Nina (Legal): also include NDA timeline — we need countersigned NDA before we receive any customer prompts.

Maya (PM): action items (assign): 
- Maya: finalize screening + outreach email (EOD Fri)
- Alex: define incentive tiers & credit amounts (Mon)
- Nina: draft simple EA addendum + telemetry consent language (Mon)
- Sam: build eval harness skeleton + toggles for hashed traces (next Wed)
- Priya: design weekly prompt regression checklist + scoreboard (next Wed)
- Jordan: ops playbook for incident escalation + fallback policy (Thu)

Alex (Solutions): i can start a short outreach list — 10 candidates (mix of enterprise + scaleups). will ping in PM doc.

Maya (PM): one more thing — gating for 'successful graduation' of a partner: 
- meets >=3 of 4 quantitative metrics (latency/cost/integration/incidents) AND
- provides at least 4 weekly feedback entries in our survey form OR participates in 2 UX interviews.

Priya (Research): that keeps it strict but fair. we should also schedule a mid-point review at week 4 to surface showstoppers.

Jordan (ProdOps): +1 to mid-point. ops can run a synthetic load test at week 3 (before heavy traffic) to validate autoscaling.

oncall-bot: Reminder: #ea-cohort-invite channel created. thread archived in 48h if no updates.

Maya (PM): perfect. i'll post the finalized recruiting doc after Alex shares incentives. thanks all :thumbsup:
